Definition: a sack (as tied at the mouth)
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses tsiqlôn where it means a sack, a bag. In 2 Kings 4:42, full ears of corn in the husk thereof.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsiqlôn exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
